title: Retrieval, fusion, and reranking
subtitle: Find candidates, enforce constraints, then spend ranking effort wisely.
goal: Find the passages that can actually answer the question
intro: Candidate search, ranking, and evidence selection solve different problems.
terms: How much relevant material was found
case: A question contains both a product code and ordinary language.
Hybrid search can recover exact identifiers and semantic paraphrases.
A reranker cannot recover evidence missing from the candidate list.
